oneLiner: 同种电荷相斥、异种相吸；F=k·q₁q₂/r²。
oneLinerEn: Like charges repel, unlike attract; F=k·q₁q₂/r².
detail: 电荷守恒：电荷既不能创生也不能消灭，只能转移。其中 k 为静电力常量，q₁、q₂ 为两点电荷电量，r 为间距。
detailEn: Charge is conserved: it can only be transferred, never created or destroyed. k electrostatic constant, q₁/q₂ charges, r distance.

oneLiner: 电荷周围存在电场；E=F/q，方向为正电荷受力方向。
oneLinerEn: A charge creates an electric field; E=F/q, directed as a positive test charge is pushed.
detail: 电场线从正电荷出发、终止于负电荷，疏密表强弱。其中 E 为电场强度，F 为试探电荷受力，q 为试探电荷电量。
detailEn: Field lines start at + and end at −; density shows strength. E field strength, F force on test charge, q test charge.

oneLiner: 电势差即电压 U=W/q；沿电场线电势降低。
oneLinerEn: Potential difference is voltage U=W/q; potential drops along field lines.
detail: 等势面与电场线垂直；带电粒子在等势面上移动电场力不做功。其中 U 为电势差（电压），W 为电场力做的功，q 为电荷电量。
detailEn: Equipotentials are perpendicular to field lines; moving on one costs no work. U potential difference (voltage), W work by field, q charge.

oneLiner: 电容器储存电荷的本领：C=Q/U。
oneLinerEn: A capacitor's ability to store charge: C=Q/U.
detail: 平行板电容 C=εS/d，与极板面积和介电常数成正比、与间距成反比。其中 C 为电容，Q 为极板带电量，U 为电压，ε 为介电常数，S 为极板面积，d 为间距。
detailEn: Parallel-plate C=εS/d, proportional to area and permittivity, inverse to spacing. C capacitance, Q charge, U voltage, ε permittivity, S area, d spacing.

oneLiner: 电流 I=Q/t；电阻 R=U/I；欧姆定律 U=IR。
oneLinerEn: Current I=Q/t; resistance R=U/I; Ohm's law U=IR.
detail: 电阻与材料、长度、横截面积和温度有关：R=ρL/S。其中 I 为电流，Q 为电荷量，t 为时间，R 为电阻，U 为电压，ρ 为电阻率，L 为长度，S 为横截面积。
detailEn: Resistance depends on material, length, area and temperature: R=ρL/S. I current, Q charge, t time, R resistance, U voltage, ρ resistivity, L length, S area.

oneLiner: 串联电流相等、电压分压；并联电压相等、电流分流。
oneLinerEn: Series: same current, shared voltage; parallel: same voltage, shared current.
detail: 总电阻串联相加、并联倒数相加。
detailEn: Total R adds in series, adds in reciprocal in parallel.

detail: 纯电阻电路中 P=I²R=U²/R。其中 W 为电功，P 为电功率，U 为电压，I 为电流，t 为时间，R 为电阻。
detailEn: For pure resistors P=I²R=U²/R. W electrical work, P power, U voltage, I current, t time, R resistance.

detail: 电炉、保险丝都利用电流的热效应。其中 Q 为产生的热量，I 为电流，R 为电阻，t 为通电时间。
detailEn: Heaters and fuses exploit the heating effect of current. Q heat produced, I current, R resistance, t time.

oneLiner: 磁体、电流周围存在磁场；可用安培定则判断方向。
oneLinerEn: Magnets and currents create magnetic fields; use the right-hand rule for direction.
detail: 奥斯特实验首次证明电流能产生磁场。
detailEn: Oersted first showed a current produces a magnetic field.

oneLiner: 通电导线在磁场中受力：F=BIL·sinθ。
oneLinerEn: A current-carrying wire feels F=BIL·sinθ in a field.
detail: 电动机即利用安培力使线圈转动。其中 F 为安培力，B 为磁感应强度，I 为电流，L 为导线长度，θ 为电流与磁场方向夹角。
detailEn: Electric motors use Ampere force to spin coils. F Ampere force, B field, I current, L length, θ angle between I and B.

oneLiner: 运动电荷在磁场中受力：f=qvB·sinθ，方向用左手定则。
oneLinerEn: A moving charge feels f=qvB·sinθ, direction by the left-hand rule.
detail: 洛伦兹力不改变速率，只改变速度方向，使其做圆周或螺旋运动。其中 f 为洛伦兹力，q 为电荷量，v 为速度，B 为磁感应强度，θ 为速度与磁场方向夹角。
detailEn: Lorentz force changes direction, not speed, giving circular or helical paths. f Lorentz force, q charge, v velocity, B field, θ angle.

oneLiner: 磁通量变化产生感应电动势：法拉第定律与楞次定律。
oneLinerEn: Changing flux induces EMF: Faraday's and Lenz's laws.
detail: 发电机、变压器都基于电磁感应；楞次定律指出感应电流总是阻碍变化。
detailEn: Generators and transformers rely on it; Lenz's law says induced current opposes the change.

oneLiner: 变化的电场与磁场相互激发，形成传播的电磁波。
oneLinerEn: Changing E and B fields sustain each other as traveling EM waves.
detail: 麦克斯韦统一电磁并预言电磁波；赫兹实验证实。频谱含无线电、可见光、X 射线等。
detailEn: Maxwell unified EM and predicted waves; Hertz confirmed them; the spectrum spans radio to X-rays.

oneLiner: 电流大小与方向随时间周期性变化，家用电即正弦式交流电。
oneLinerEn: Current whose magnitude and direction cycle over time; mains supply is sinusoidal AC.
detail: 用峰值、有效值与频率描述：正弦交流电有效值等于峰值除以根号2；我国市电为 220 伏、50 赫兹，即每秒方向改变一百次。交流便于变压与远距离输送。
detailEn: Described by peak, RMS and frequency: for a sine wave RMS equals peak over root-two; China's mains are 220 V, 50 Hz, reversing direction 100 times a second. AC suits transformation and long-distance transmission.

oneLiner: 利用互感把交流电压升高或降低，理想变压器输入功率等于输出功率。
oneLinerEn: Uses mutual induction to raise or lower AC voltage; an ideal transformer conserves power.
detail: 原、副线圈电压比等于匝数比，电流比则与之相反。升压利于输电、降压利于用电，闭合铁芯能提高磁耦合效率。
detailEn: Primary-to-secondary voltage equals the turn ratio while current ratio is inverted. Step-up aids transmission, step-down aids use; a closed iron core improves coupling.

oneLiner: 导体自身电流变化会在本回路激起感应电动势，两线圈之间则相互感应。
oneLinerEn: A changing current induces EMF in its own circuit (self) and in a neighboring coil (mutual).
detail: 自感电动势总是阻碍电流变化，使通电、断电呈现延时；线圈的自感系数以亨利为单位。互感是变压器与无线充电的原理。
detailEn: Self-induced EMF opposes current change, giving switch-on and switch-off lag; inductance is measured in henries. Mutual induction underlies transformers and wireless charging.

term: 电磁振荡与电磁波发射
oneLiner: 电容与电感回路中电场能与磁场能周期互转，产生高频振荡，是发射电磁波的基础。
oneLinerEn: In an LC circuit electric and magnetic energy trade periodically, giving high-frequency oscillation—the basis of emitting EM waves.
detail: 振荡频率由电感与电容共同决定；要有效辐射需高频且采用开放电路，故无线电通信使用极高的载波频率。
detailEn: The oscillation frequency is set by inductance and capacitance; efficient radiation needs high frequency and an open circuit, so radio uses very high carriers.
